description: Weighing indicators with Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP
source: Alfa Instrumentos user manual 0132-MN-03, 3100D/DS weighing indicators, Modbus TCP commands

sources.title: Manual do usuário Indicadores de Pesagem Linha 3100D/DS (0132-MN-03)
sources.note: Section 6.1, Modbus TCP commands (same register layout as Modbus RTU)

notes: The manual says the Modbus TCP commands keep the structure of the Modbus RTU ones; the RTU command manual 0060MN was not available, so this map follows section 6.1 of 0132-MN-03.
Registers are numbered as in the manual, which gives the same number in decimal and in hexadecimal start addresses (register 80 is 0x0050).
Supported functions: 0x03 read, 0x06 write one register, 0x10 write several registers.

The weight and tare are 32-bit counts; the manual does not state the word order (big assumed), the sign (a separate flag in register 80) or a scale. Divide by 10 to the power of the decimal places in bits 0 to 2 of register 80.
Registers 160 to 165 set the clock together with function 0x10; the manual lists register 163 as hour and the quantity as 6.
The manual gives the editable tare as start register 850 with quantity 2 but names registers 851 and 852; 851 and 852 are used here.
Serial defaults: 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits; baud rates 4800 to 230400. Factory device address 01.
Level numbering: values and states are given for levels 0 to 7 depending on the model (3104D/DS has 4 levels, 3107D/DS has 8).
